titre: Le marché mondial de la mode d'occasion
sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, 2025 constaté puis projections 2026 et 2030

series.nom: Marché mondial de la mode d'occasion

2025.texte: The global secondhand apparel market grew 13% year-over-year in 2025, reaching an estimated $257 billion.

2026.texte: The global secondhand apparel market is projected at $289 billion in 2026

2030.texte: The global secondhand market is projected to reach $393 billion by 2030
